testedSource.history: First pass (typecheck, vitest 266, browser 16) ran on a CRLF copy 9859d6d2… written by git apply under core.autocrlf=true; LF-normalized identical. After review, the tree was rebuilt with core.autocrlf=false and typecheck + vitest were rerun on the LF source (this record). Browser specs were not rerun; they ran once on the CRLF copy, whose code is identical apart from line endings, and the JS bundle built from either is byte-identical (32bcd9c6…).
